runner_note: The teacher's runners (commit 6d0d0a7e) and this round's final attempt's (session commit 8f74bc94) differ. Fluid: run_battery.py e650539e... then, 805d3dbd... now: tool-task support (tools, env_factory, a task's own system text), engine metrics, splitting the task file on newlines only, an optional time box and submission order, the engine's max_num_seqs, and abort_request([id]) (commit 30494d3b); no fluid_reasoning_720 item carries tools or a system field, and the teacher run parsed all 720 lines. Capability: uncapped_eval.py cd4b1888... then, aef2658c... now (generation source digest 9eb5d477... then, 153e295c... now): an optional --max-num-seqs and abort_request([id]); degeneration.py (79354082...) and behavior.py are unchanged. In both, a record is taken at its stop and a stopped request's later output is dropped (`pending` no longer holds it), so the abort repair changes what the engine keeps running after a stop, not what a sealed record holds (the statements that build a non-fluid prompt are the same at both session commits: construction_path) (analysis.py :: stop_record_integrity checks this on every sealed degeneration stop). It does not make a rerun reproduce the teacher's records token for token: batch composition differs (bf16 batch nondeterminism), so any regeneration is a new sample under the same seeds.
